comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Mainly a rural Alaska electric utility with hydro generation; telecom is secondary, so the business differs.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Owns broadband, cable, fiber and tower networks serving consumers, businesses and carriers; similar mix of retail and wholesale services.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Diversified holding company dominated by billboards and insurance; the small fiber broadband unit doesn't define the business.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Contractor building networks for carriers, project-based revenue; not an operator of subscriber broadband networks.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Owns fiber and cable networks selling broadband, video, voice, business data and wholesale capacity; same business, different region.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: TDS Telecom sells fiber broadband, video and voice to residential and business customers in smaller markets, plus towers.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Owns fiber networks selling consumer and business broadband plus wholesale fiber transport to carriers; closely overlapping services.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Satellite operator and defense equipment maker; different technology, customers and revenue mix from terrestrial fiber broadband.
